title: SearchFacetsResponse
description: If the request includes `field`: array with a single facet. Otherwise all facet objects with their values.

name.description: Display name of the facet as shown in the UI.

type.description: Facet type (for example: multi-select, select, tags) as configured in search filters.

values.description: Available facet values with their result counts.

value.description: Facet value (for example: a category or product name).

count.description: Number of search results that match this facet value.
